evidence.title: I've been building an animation library for years — here's SmoothUI - DEV Community

name: I've been building an animation library for years — here's SmoothUI
summary: dev.to write-up on SmoothUI, a free open source set of 75+ animated React components compatible with shadcn/ui.
description: Post by SmoothUI's author on how the library grew from an animation sandbox into a shadcn-compatible component library, with a tour of five components (Magnetic Button, Scrollable Card Stack, Siri Orb, Expandable Cards, Gooey Popover), notes on reduced-motion handling and the stack: React 19, Motion 12 and Tailwind CSS v4, MIT licensed.
contains: free, open source set of 75+ animated React components
five featured components: Magnetic Button, Scrollable Card Stack, Siri Orb, Expandable Cards, Gooey Popover
components install individually with npx shadcn add @smoothui/<name>
React 19, Motion 12, Tailwind CSS v4; MIT licensed
planned: @smoothui/cli and an MCP server for component discovery
